title: 3Metrics
tagline: 3Metrics is a project for Scaling Ethereum, more coming soon...
description: The telemetry dashboard for web3 DApps provides users with a comprehensive interface for monitoring and interacting with data from the local blockchain and Graph. Through a simple terminal-based display, users can seamlessly navigate through wallet information, with each wallet item numbered and selectable. Upon selection, users can trigger actions by pressing Enter, facilitating efficient interaction with the displayed data. This intuitive interface empowers users to efficiently monitor system metrics and wallet data, enhancing their ability to analyze and manage their web3 DApp environments effectively.
how_its_made: The telemetry dashboard for web3 DApps is built using a combination of cutting-edge technologies to deliver a seamless user experience. Uses Arbitrum Stylus to write Smart Contracts that can have their metrics carefully logged and visualized. Uses Sign Protocol to store some metric data. And Filecoin for scalability and storage, incorporating IPC.
